answer: Bonded escrows make identities costly, while correlation analysis links conflicting signatures across a coordinated set. For k identities that equivocate together, pairwise penalties scale as O(k^2), so splitting control among sybils does not dilute liability. Detection can trigger an exponential multiplier in capital loss under asymmetric depreciation: a vine of linked keys leaves a signal, and even onyx-backed collateral remains exposed.
